_comment: One face: keep the two lines below. Several faces - a client and the API behind it, a CLI and its server - delete them and use the `targets` list instead, one entry per face, each with a `name`, exactly one of `url` (it listens on a port) or `command` (it does not), and its own `contains`. Never both forms at once, at most 4 targets, and every one has to be identified. Replace `contains` with a marker only this project's own output carries - ok / healthy / 200 are not markers, and neither is the version string: genai.release moves it after the round's last acceptance run, so a version in here refuses the NEXT round with wrong_service and that round may not edit this file. Delete this line.
